issues.description: Interface name mismatch: the problem statement and template expect an interface named 'Rideable' with a method messageOnRide(), but the solution implementation defines an interface named 'Mountable' (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Mountable.java) and has Pig and Seal implement Mountable. The solution also contains an effectively empty Rideable.java file (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Rideable.java). This inconsistent identifier usage (Rideable vs Mountable) will confuse students about which interface to implement and may cause compilation or automated grading failures because callers in the template/problem refer to Rideable while the solution classes implement Mountable.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred remediation: rename the solution's Mountable interface to Rideable (move/rename Mountable.java -> Rideable.java) and update Pig.java and Seal.java to implement Rideable. Remove the empty Rideable.java file in the solution. Ensure the unified Rideable interface declares String messageOnRide() so it matches the problem statement and the template Main usage. Alternatively, if 'Mountable' is the intended name, update the problem statement and template to reference 'Mountable' consistently.
